scope: PR6 DEVELOPMENT ONLY, prospectively specified before CODE outcomes; Georgia was inspected in Stage A and is not a new confirmation cohort
selection_rule: minimum unweighted masked ECG-level validation BCE, earliest epoch for exact tie; no Georgia metric used
